_: THE SWEEP THAT SAYS ROUND 1084's GATE IS NOT VACUOUS — run it from the
The gate's OWN first three runs are the other half of the proof and they are
already recorded: pointed at the tree one commit before this round's
repairs, it named eleven tests that exist and that no CI command runs, and
pointed at the tree after them it names none. What that cannot show is
whether the tests in `tests/gate.rs` would notice if a mechanism stopped
working — a fixture-based test can pass because the fixture is wrong as
easily as because the code is right. Each injection below removes one
mechanism and names the test that must go red for it.
Scoped to this crate's own suite: nothing here touches the tree it judges,
so running the repository's whole suite would be five minutes of proving

injections.name: the-ignored-subtraction-is-removed
injections.why: `--list` prints ignored tests too, so crediting a command with what it LISTS credits it with tests it skips; without the subtraction an `#[ignore]` nobody ever passes `--ignored` for reads as covered, which is nine of the eleven this gate found

injections.name: the-doc-tests-are-not-asked-for
injections.why: a doc-test has no test binary, so cargo's artifact record never mentions one; without its own probe they are missing from the population AND from the run set at once, which produces no finding and hid a `​```ignore` example this gate later named

injections.name: every-target-counts-as-a-library
injections.why: `cargo test --doc` on a package with no library exits non-zero saying so; reading that as a refusal makes this gate reject three of this repository's workspaces for a reason outside its own law, which is the shape R1081 shipped and had to repair inside the round

injections.name: the-population-stops-asking-for-every-feature
injections.why: a test behind a feature is invisible to a build that does not enable it — the mechanism that hid nine `mnemosyne-server` tests through R583..R1081 — so a population probe without `--all-features` cannot see the very class this gate exists for

injections.name: a-tree-that-did-not-compile-reports-clean
injections.why: a gate that could not look and a gate that looked and found nothing print the same silence; R1078 shipped a run reporting zero unresolved citations because rustdoc had refused to start, and this is where that cannot happen again

injections.name: dark-is-inverted
injections.why: the finding set is the whole verdict and it had no test at all until this sweep went looking for something to break here; inverted, the gate reports a covered repository as an uncovered one and every other test in the crate stays green
